source("/home/marinani/Scripts/Data_analysis/feature_plots.r")

#### Prepare the data
Load the data
```{r load data}

seurat <- readRDS("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Protocol_optimization/seurat_integrated.rds")
seurat$type <- "invitro"

## logCP10k-primary vs. logUMInorm-organoid
load("/links/groups/treutlein/USERS/zhisong_he/Work/public_datasets/Kracht_Science_2020_human_fetal_microglia_scRNAseq_ATACseq/niches_avgExpr_meta.RData")

## DE to primary fetal microglia
seurat_MG <- readRDS("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Co-culture_timecourse/Kracht_primary_microglia_seurat.rds")
seurat_MG$type <- "primary"

# Load uwot model
umap_model <- load_uwot(file="/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Co-culture_timecourse/kracht_uwot_model_pca.uwot")

```

# DESeq comapred to Kracht per condition only

Rename the metadata of the two seurat objects to match
```{r rename metadata}

seurat_MG$condition <- seurat_MG$celltype
seurat_MG$cluster <- seurat_MG$timepoint_wks
seurat$cluster <- seurat$RNA_snn_res.0.3

```

Merge the two sseurat objects
```{r merge the two objects}

merged <- merge(seurat, seurat_MG)

```

Generate a SingleCellExperiment object from the merged seurat objects
```{r genearte a SingleCellExperiment object}

# Extract raw counts and metadata to create SingleCellExperiment object
counts <- merged@assays$RNA@counts 

metadata <- merged@meta.data

# Set up metadata as desired for aggregation and DE analysis
metadata$cluster_id <- factor(merged@active.ident)

# Create single cell experiment object
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = counts), 
                           colData = metadata)

```

Take a look at the count matrix
```{r count matrix and metadata}

# Explore the raw counts for the dataset

## Check the assays present
assays(sce)

## Check the counts matrix
dim(counts(sce))
counts(sce)[1:6, 1:6]

# Explore the cellular metadata for the dataset

dim(colData(sce))
head(colData(sce))

# Remove unnecessary columns
sce$HTO_secondID <- NULL
sce$HTO_maxID <- NULL
sce$HTO_margin <- NULL
sce$HTO_classification <- NULL
sce$HTO_classification.global <- NULL
sce$RNA_snn_res.0.1 <- NULL
sce$RNA_snn_res.0.2 <- NULL
sce$RNA_snn_res.0.3 <- NULL
sce$RNA_snn_res.0.5 <- NULL
sce$RNA_snn_res.0.4 <- NULL
sce$RNA_snn_res.0.6 <- NULL
sce$RNA_snn_res.0.8 <- NULL
sce$RNA_snn_res.10 <- NULL
sce$RNA_css_snn_res.0.5 <- NULL
sce$RNA_css_snn_res.0.3 <- NULL
sce$RNA_css_snn_res.1 <- NULL
sce$cluster_id <- NULL
sce$log10NCount_RNA <- NULL

# Add a column with cluster and condition
sce$condition_cluster <- paste0(sce$condition, "_", sce$cluster)

```

```{r extract necessary metrics}

# Subset metadata to include only the variables you want to aggregate across (here, we want to aggregate by sample and by cluster)
groups <- colData(sce)[, c("condition")]
head(groups)

```

#### Aggregate matrix
Aggregate the counts to generate a matrix with count sums
```{r generate an aggregated matrix of counts per sample}

# Aggregate across cluster-sample groups
# transposing row/columns to have cell_ids as row names matching those of groups
aggr_counts <- aggregate.Matrix(t(counts(sce)), 
                                groupings = groups, fun = "sum") 

# Explore output matrix
class(aggr_counts)
dim(aggr_counts)
aggr_counts[1:6, 1:6]

# Now transpose the matrix back so we can easilty use it to do DE analysis
# Transpose aggregated matrix to have genes as rows and samples as columns
aggr_counts <- t(aggr_counts)
aggr_counts[1:6, 1:6]

```

Generate matching metadata at the sample-level
```{r}

# Explore structure of metadata
head(colData(sce))

# Extract sample-level variables
metadata <- colData(sce) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::select(condition, type)

dim(metadata)
head(metadata)

# Exclude duplicated rows
metadata <- metadata[!duplicated(metadata), ]

dim(metadata)
head(metadata)

# Rename rows
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$condition
head(metadata)

# Check the number of cells per sample and cluster
t <- table(colData(sce)$condition,
           colData(sce)$cluster)
t
type(t)

aggr_counts[1:6, 1:6]
head(metadata)

# Check matching of matrix columns and metadata rows
all(colnames(aggr_counts) == rownames(metadata)) 
# They do not, so we make them match
metadata <- metadata[match(colnames(aggr_counts), rownames(metadata)), ]

```

#### Differential expression with DESeq2

```{r DESeq2 design formula}

# Create DESeq2 object        
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(aggr_counts, 
                              colData = metadata, 
                              design = ~ type)

```

```{r run DESeq2}

# Run DESeq2 differential expression analysis
# dds <- DESeq(dds, useT=TRUE, minmu=1e-6, minReplicatesForReplace =Inf,  test = "LRT", reduced = ~ 1)
dds <- DESeq(dds)

# Plot dispersion estimates
plotDispEsts(dds)

```


```{r run vst normaliztion}

library(apeglm)
# Check the coefficients for the comparison
resultsNames(dds)

vsd <- vst(dds)
assay(vsd) <- limma::removeBatchEffect(assay(vsd), batch = vsd$type)
plotPCA(vsd, "type")
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "condition") 

```

```{r plot}

thelevels <-  factor(c("A","B", "C", "D","E", "F", "G","H", "I", "J", "Homeostatic microglia (early)", "Homeostatic microglia (late)", "Activated microglia", "Proliferating microglia", "SOX-medium microglia", "SOX-hi microglia", "Monocyte", "Perivascular macrophage", "Erythrocyte"))
vsd$condition <- factor(vsd$condition, levels = thelevels)

pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/PCA_pseudobulk_invitro_vs_kracht_per_condition_per_cluster_or_timepoint_labeled.pdf", height = 9, width = 14)
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "condition") + geom_label(aes(label = name), label.size = 0.1) + geom_point()
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/PCA_pseudobulk_invitro_vs_kracht_per_condition_per_cluster_or_timepoint.pdf", height = 9, width = 14)
pcaData <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = c("condition", "type"), returnData = TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pcaData, "percentVar"))
ggplot(pcaData, aes(PC1, PC2, color=condition, shape=type))+
  scale_colour_manual(name="",  values =c(col_sample, col_primary_ct))  +
  geom_point(size=5) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ",percentVar[1],"% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ",percentVar[2],"% variance")) + 
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_light() 
dev.off()


pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/PCA_pseudobulk_invitro_vs_kracht_per_condition_per_cluster_or_timepoint_labeled_repel.pdf", height = 8, width = 13)
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pcaData, "percentVar"))
ggplot(pcaData, aes(PC1, PC2, color=condition, shape=type)) + 
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = name), box.padding   = 0.35, point.padding = 0.5, segment.color = 'grey50',max.overlaps = 180,label.size = 0.1) +
  scale_colour_manual(name="",  values =c(col_sample, col_primary_ct)) +
  geom_point(size=5) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ",percentVar[1],"% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ",percentVar[2],"% variance")) + 
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_light() 
dev.off()

```

```{r}

# Extract the vst matrix from the object and compute pairwise correlation values
vsd_mat <- assay(vsd)
vsd_cor <- cor(vsd_mat)

# Plot heatmap
pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/PCA_pseudobulk_invitro_vs_kracht_per_condition_per_cluster_or_timepoint_heatmap.pdf", height = 18, width = 22)
pheatmap(vsd_cor, annotation = metadata[, c("condition"), drop=F], color=bluered_colscheme(100))
dev.off()

sampleDists <- dist( t( assay(vsd) ) )
sampleDists

sampleDistMatrix <- as.matrix( sampleDists ) 
rownames(sampleDistMatrix) <- paste(vsd$condition) 
colnames(sampleDistMatrix) <- paste(vsd$condition) 
# colors <- colorRampPalette( rev(brewer.pal(9, "Blues")) )(255) 

pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/Eucledian_distance_vst_transf_conditions_and_kracht.pdf", height = 9, width = 12)
pheatmap(sampleDistMatrix,
         clustering_distance_rows=sampleDists,
         clustering_distance_cols=sampleDists,
         col=hcl.colors(50, "BluYl"))
dev.off()

```


#### Results table
```{r build a results table}

res <- results(dds)
mcols(res, use.names=TRUE)
summary(res)

# Lower the FDR threshold
res.05 <- results(dds, alpha=.05) 
table(res.05$padj < .05)
# FALSE  TRUE 
# 11877 20868 

# Raise the log2 fold change threshold
resLFC1 <- results(dds, lfcThreshold=1) 
table(resLFC1$padj < 0.1)
# FALSE  TRUE 
# 15674 14478 

results(dds, contrast=c("condition", "A", "Homeostatic microglia (early)"))

```

               name = "type_primary_vs_invitro",
               alpha = 0.05)

# Shrink the log2 fold changes to be more appropriate using the apeglm method - should cite [paper]() when using this method
resLFC <- lfcShrink(dds,
                 coef = "type_primary_vs_invitro",
                 res=res,
                 type = "apeglm")

plotMA(resLFC, ylim=c(-23,23))

plotCounts(dds, gene=which.min(res$padj), intgroup="type")

# Differential expression with DESeq2

```{r DESeq2 design formula}

# Create DESeq2 object        
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(aggr_counts, 
                              colData = metadata, 
                              design = ~ orig.ident + condition)

dds$condition <- factor(dds$condition, levels = mg_cond_levels)
  
```

```{r PCA}

# Transform counts for data visualization
vsd <- vst(dds, blind=TRUE)

# Plot PCA
DESeq2::plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "condition") 

```

```{r}

# Extract the rlog matrix from the object and compute pairwise correlation values
vsd_mat <- assay(vsd)
vsd_cor <- cor(vsd_mat)

# Plot heatmap
pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/similarity_between_vst_transf_conditions.pdf", height = 7, width = 10)
pheatmap(vsd_cor, annotation = metadata[, c("condition"), drop=F], color = bluered_colscheme(100))
dev.off()

sampleDists <- dist( t( assay(vsd) ) )
sampleDists

sampleDistMatrix <- as.matrix( sampleDists ) 
rownames(sampleDistMatrix) <- paste(vsd$condition, vsd$orig.ident, sep="-" ) 
colnames(sampleDistMatrix) <- paste(vsd$condition, vsd$orig.ident, sep="-" ) 
# colors <- colorRampPalette( rev(brewer.pal(9, "Blues")) )(255) 

pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/Eucledian_distance_between_vst_transf_conditions.pdf", height = 7, width = 10)
pheatmap(sampleDistMatrix,
         clustering_distance_rows=sampleDists,
         clustering_distance_cols=sampleDists,
         col=hcl.colors(50, "BluYl"))
dev.off()

```

```{r}

# Run DESeq2 differential expression analysis
dds <- DESeq(dds, useT=TRUE, minmu=1e-6, minReplicatesForReplace =Inf,  test = "LRT", reduced = ~ 1)

# Plot dispersion estimates
plotDispEsts(dds)

```

```{r plot counts}

resTC <- results(dds)
resTC$symbol <- mcols(dds)$symbol
head(resTC[order(resTC$padj),],4)

data <- plotCounts(dds, which.min(resTC$padj),
                   intgroup = c("orig.ident", "condition"), returnData = TRUE)
ggplot(data, aes(x = orig.ident, y = count, color = condition, group = condition)) + 
  geom_point() + stat_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "loess") + scale_y_log10()

```
```{r}

resultsNames(dds)

betas <- coef(dds)
colnames(betas)

topGenes <- head(order(resTC$padj),30)
mat <- betas[topGenes, -c(1,2)]
thr <- 3
mat[mat < -thr] <- -thr
mat[mat > thr] <- thr

pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/DESeq2_heatmap_DE_comparison_across_conditions_based_on_J_vs_A.pdf",  width = 6, height = 8)
pheatmap(mat, breaks=seq(from=-thr, to=thr, length=101),
	  cluster_col=FALSE, color =bluered_colscheme(100)) 
dev.off()

```

```{r}


resJ_A <- results(dds, name = "condition_J_vs_A", test = "Wald")
resJ_A[which.min(resTC$padj),]

# Turn the DESeq2 results object into a tibble for use with tidyverse functions
resJ_A_tbl <- resJ_A %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "gene") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  arrange(padj)

# Check results output
resJ_A_tbl 

# Set thresholds
# padj_cutoff <- 0.05

# Subset the significant results
sig_res <- dplyr::filter(resJ_A_tbl) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(padj) %>%
  mutate(DE = abs(log2FoldChange)>log(1.5) & padj < 0.01) %>%
  mutate(DEG = ifelse(abs(log2FoldChange)>log(1.5) & padj < 0.01, gene, NA))

# Check significant genes output
sig_res

# Add to the table another column wtih outcome
sig_res <- sig_res %>% 
  mutate(
    outcome = case_when(log2FoldChange > log(1.5) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Up-regulated",
                           log2FoldChange < -log(1.5) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Down-regulated",
                           TRUE ~ "Unchanged")
    )
head(sig_res) 

sig_res$padj[sig_res$padj == 0.000000e+00] <- min(sig_res$padj[which(sig_res$padj != 0)])

plot <- ggplot(sig_res, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj),label=DEG)) +
  geom_point(shape=21, size=2, aes(fill=outcome), position = "jitter") +
  #geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 30) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(0),  linetype="dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(1), linetype="dotted") +
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#58B6AC", "gray50", "#C73E04")) +
  xlab(expression("log"[2]*"FC")) + 
  ylab(expression("-log"[10]*"p_adj")) +
  ggtitle("DEGs between condition J and A")


pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/DESeq2_volcano_DE_J_vs_A.pdf", height = 5, width = 8)
plot +
  geom_label_repel(data = sig_res, mapping = aes(log2FoldChange, -log10(padj), label = DEG), size = 3, max.overlaps = 50, force = 5, force_pull = 0.5)
dev.off()

```
